Remark
[Relative volume comparison for geodesically star-shaped sets] Source: cheeger-gromov-taylor:page-0029 1. Remark 4.1\group section-4

Suppose $S\subset M^n$ contains the unique minimizing geodesic from $p$ to each $q\in S$ outside the cut locus of $p$. Proposition 5 remains valid with $V_r(p)$ replaced by $V(S\cap B_r(p))$.
